questions.answer: Decorators enable reusable functionality such as logging, authentication, timing, and caching without modifying the original code.

questions.question: What is method overriding?
questions.answer: Method overriding occurs when a subclass provides its own implementation of a method already defined in the parent class.

questions.question: What is Heap Sort?
questions.answer: Heap Sort is a comparison-based sorting algorithm that uses a heap and runs in O(n log n) time.

questions.question: What is the TCP four-way handshake?
questions.answer: The TCP four-way handshake is used to gracefully terminate a TCP connection.

questions.answer: A data model defines how data is structured, stored, and related within a database.

questions.question: What is the difference between a mutex and a semaphore?
questions.answer: A mutex has ownership and can only be unlocked by the thread that locked it, whereas a semaphore does not have ownership restrictions.

questions.answer: The except block handles exceptions raised in the corresponding try block.

questions.question: What is virtual memory?
questions.answer: Virtual memory is a memory management technique that allows processes to use more memory than physically available by utilizing secondary storage.
